description.value: Phở Zen is a Vietnamese restaurant opened in 2023 on Southeast Marine Drive in Vancouver, specializing in traditional beef noodle soup made with house-crafted broth, rice noodles, and fresh herbs including Thai basil and culantro. The menu emphasizes seasonal Vietnamese dishes and drinks alongside the core phở program, and the restaurant operates as both a sit-down dining room and bar. Online ordering is available for those wanting a quick stop.

address.value: 654 SE Marine Dr, Vancouver BC V5X2T4, Canada
